issues.message: One-way PEC physical optics is unvalidated: no antenna loading/S11 feedback, edge diffraction, multiple scattering or geometric shadowing.

EMerge complex angular samples are explicitly assumed to be outgoing far-zone coefficients with e^(+j omega t), phase origin at the placed antenna origin. No absolute voltage, power, gain or compliance calibration is claimed.
